page.overview:
Who is Phoebe?

Pheobe is a character introduced in the Generation III games. She is a member of the Hoenn Elite Four who specializes in the use of -type Pokémon.

Phoebe is a small and very slender little girl with short spiky black hair, barefoot, tan skin and blue eyes with two big red Hawaiian style cornflowers that cover the sides of her head. She wears a blue two-piece sarong like dress with a strapless bra, white Hawaiian style cornflowers and a Pokémon logo on it. She wears nothing in her feet besides a red ankle bracelet on her left foot.

She is a strong trainer who cares deeply about bonds with her Pokémon. Much like her choice of Pokémon, Phoebe displays a cheerful and fun-loving personality which may explain why she seems younger than the other members of the Elite Four.

The name Phoebe likely comes from "phobia" (fear) or "phantom".
